description: The agent must: (1) Read the raw usage JSON at workspace/clients/alfreds_plumbing/usage_stats_raw.json and communication log to extract real metrics. (2) Produce monthly_value_report.txt following the SKILL.md Pillar 2 template — must include real numbers (messages, bookings, dollar values), show ROI vs $149 investment, and CRITICALLY must end with a question as mandated by the skill. (3) Produce churn_prevention_plan.txt following the exact 5-step churn playbook: reach out immediately → listen first → offer solutions (MUST explicitly include 'pause' option per 'Pause > Cancel' rule) → quantify what Alfred will lose in dollar terms (captured bookings * $180/booking value) → gracious exit with feedback request. Must also identify the specific signals: Sarah leaving, usage drop to 9 messages, contract terms inquiry, no check-in reply. (4) Produce revenue_model_recommendation.txt recommending annual billing using the EXACT proprietary figures from SKILL.md: $1,490/year (not a calculated approximation) and specifically the 17% savings figure, plus timing rationale tied to the month 2-3 value demonstration window from the skill. The agent must navigate away from the distractor 'generic churn notes' file and the outdated templates, relying on the SKILL.md framework throughout.
